def lin(p,b,f):
    # projection t of p-b onto f-b
    vb=[f[i]-b[i] for i in range(3)]
    vp=[p[i]-b[i] for i in range(3)]
    den=sum(x*x for x in vb)
    t=sum(vp[i]*vb[i] for i in range(3))/den
    # residual distance from line
    proj=[b[i]+t*vb[i] for i in range(3)]
    res=math.sqrt(sum((p[i]-proj[i])**2 for i in range(3)))
    return t,res
cells={}

im=Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
files='abcdefgh'
bgs=[(240,217,181),(181,136,99)]

def mask_for_cell(name):
    c=files.index(name[0]); r=8-int(name[1:]); x0=c*80;y0=r*80
    bg=bgs[(r+c)%2]
    wd=bk=0
    for y in range(y0,y0+80):
      for x in range(x0,x0+80):
        p=im.getpixel((x,y))
        if min(p)>240: wd+=1
        if max(p)<60: bk+=1
    fg=(255,255,255) if wd>=20 else (0,0,0)
    m=Image.new('L',(80,80),0); px=m.load()
    vb=[fg[i]-bg[i] for i in range(3)]; den=sum(v*v for v in vb)
    for y in range(y0,y0+80):
      for x in range(x0,x0+80):
        p=im.getpixel((x,y))
        vp=[p[i]-bg[i] for i in range(3)]
        t=sum(vp[i]*vb[i] for i in range(3))/den
        proj=[bg[i]+t*vb[i] for i in range(3)]
        res=math.sqrt(sum((p[i]-proj[i])**2 for i in range(3)))
        if t>0.5 and res<60: px[x-x0,y-y0]=255
    return m,'W' if fg[0] else 'B'

def norm(m, size=48):
    bb=m.getbbox()
    if not bb: return None
    m=m.crop(bb)
    # pad to square preserving aspect
    w,h=m.size; s=max(w,h)
    sq=Image.new('L',(s,s),0); sq.paste(m,((s-w)//2,(s-h)//2))
    return sq.resize((size,size),Image.Resampling.NEAREST)

fontpath='/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf'

        d.text((60,60),ch,fill=255,font=font,anchor='mm')
        nm=norm(img)
        if nm is not None: templates[(size,sym)]=nm

def iou(a,b):
    pa=a.load();pb=b.load(); inter=uni=0
    for y in range(a.height):
      for x in range(a.width):
        u=pa[x,y]>128; v=pb[x,y]>128
        inter+=u and v; uni+=u or v
    return inter/uni if uni else 0

for r in range(8):

    m,color=mask_for_cell(name)

    # occupancy threshold
    if sum(1 for p in m.getdata() if p)/255 < 50: continue
    nm=norm(m)

        if (color=='W') != sym.isupper(): continue
